name: "Break-glass" accounts MUST be disabled by default and alert immediately upon usage to prevent abuse and unauthorised use.
conditionsText: Applies to Identity platforms, Cloud Platform administration, Privileged access management systems, CI/CD and source control platforms and production infrastructure
requirementTitle: "Break-glass" accounts MUST be disabled by default and alert immediately upon usage to prevent abuse and unauthorised use.
requirementDescription: Emergency ("break-glass") accounts should not be available for everyday use. They should only be enabled or used in exceptional situations, and any use of them should generate an immediate alert so it can be investigated.
why:
Because break-glass accounts are:
- Necessary for recovery during emergencies.
- Extremely powerful, making them attractive targets for attackers.
tasks: "Break-glass" accounts MUST be disabled by default and alert immediately upon usage to prevent abuse and unauthorised use.

actions.title: "Break-glass" accounts MUST be disabled by default and alert immediately upon usage to prevent abuse and unauthorised use.
actions.description: Emergency administrator accounts should only be used as a last resort. They should not be active for normal work, and whenever they are used, the security team should be alerted immediately so any misuse can be detected and investigated.
